entities.summary: Covide is a Portuguese freguesia, located in the municipality of Terras de Bouro in the district of Braga. The population in 2011 was 343, in an area of 19.87 km2. The village is located on the outskirts of the Peneda-Gerês National Park. The Via Nova, a Roman road crosses through the village.
